contract.description: The view contract the elements were built for, as `"1.1"`.

controls.description: Each control the module registers, which edits or shows an input of one pin type.

node_bodies.description: Each node body the module registers, which draws the inside of one node type's node.

type.description: The pin type whose inputs the control edits or shows.

control.description:
The control's name, which a pin's `control` annotation picks it by. Left out, the control
is its pin type's default.

script.description: The script that default-exports the control's element class, inside the node UI folder.

NodeUiManifestControl.description: A control a module registers for one pin type.

oneOf.description: True or false.
A whole number, exact to 2^53, or within the exact size the type states.
A number, held as a 64-bit float unless the type states a size.
Text.
One of a fixed list of option names.
An sRGB colour with alpha, four numbers from 0 to 1.
Two, three or four numbers, named x, y, z and w.
A rectangle by its left and top edges, width and height.
A 4 by 4 matrix, row by row.
A GPU picture, in one of the pixel formats the type states.
A stream of audio samples.
Encoded video, one access unit per message, in one of the codecs the type states.
Encoded audio, one packet per message, in one of the codecs the type states.
An array of numbers with a shape.
One of the project's assets, of the media the type states.
An event with no payload; its message's timestamp is the event.
A list of values of the one type it names.
Named members, each of its own type, carried as one message. It has no name of its own: two bundles with the same members are one type.
A type a module declares by its class, carried as the bytes that class packs.
A setting naming another node of the graph. It never takes a wire.
A setting that chooses another port's pin type; its value is a pin type. It never takes a wire.

BuiltInPinTypeName.description: The name of a built-in pin type: the `type` tag of its pin type.

node_type.description: The node type whose node it draws, as `acme:Crossfade`.

script.description: The script that default-exports the node body's element class, inside the node UI folder.

NodeUiManifestNodeBody.description: A node body a module registers for one node type.
